_comment: Example parameter sweep. Each run starts from the project config.json, applies its dotted 'overrides' (any config key, so you control not just WHICH scenarios run but also WHAT they do — mode, objective, grid fees, season, penetration, …), and runs the listed scenarios into output/<name>/ (with the resolved config_used.json). Run with: python run.py sweep configs/sweep.example.json. Use 'all' to run every scenario. This example compares charging strategies in a winter week.
